usage: Vendor, loot, and stash. Account heroes carry its typed effects into fights while it is equipped (and attuned, when required).

srd.text:
_Potion, Rare_

When you drink this potion, you gain 10 Temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour. For the same duration, you are under the effect of the _Bless_ spell (no Concentration required).

This potion's blue liquid bubbles and steams as if boiling.
